title: Better Mining Bar
description: This texture improves the mining progress bar
body:
![Better Mining bar](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/311bf63d8b08cf7646600bbd4de1ade3f9896249_0.webp)

Have you ever noticed how hard it is to see the mining progress bar in Minecraft? This texture fixes that, making it much clearer while you're breaking blocks.

The bar has been redesigned to be simple and easy to read, without cluttering the screen and still matching the game's vanilla style.

Features:

Simple and clean design
Better visibility of mining progress
Keeps the vanilla look
Works with different blocks (dirt, sand, etc.)

Compatible with all recent versions of Minecraft
